title: NASA Human Research Program Evidence Book: Risk of Cardiac Rhythm Problems in Spaceflight - Executive Summary (Clinical Overview)
content: [NASA HRP] Executive Summary: Microgravity induces significant cardiovascular remodeling. The cephalad fluid shift redistributes approximately 1.5 to 2 liters of interstitial and intravascular fluid from the lower extremities toward the thorax and head. This acute central hypervolemia alters autonomic tone and cardiac baroreflex sensitivity. This operational finding represents core spaceflight health guidelines for crew safety and physiological stability.
